author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-RobustMADComBat: Robust MAD-based ComBat Embedding + Residualized Balanced Graph
abstract: Dual-output pipeline using a robust, MAD-based ComBat on the normalized/log1p matrix for the embedding (PCA64) and our residualized PC50 + equal-quota balanced cosine kNN (k=48, binary) for the graph. Label-free and simple; aims to improve cell_cycle/kBET while retaining overall balance.
